setup.title: Biscuit Cooks Dinner
setup.style: 3D animated cartoon with soft rounded shapes, warm saturated colors and gentle lighting, a sunny little town, a small corner supermarket and a cozy home kitchen; one continuous shot per prompt.

cast.name: Biscuit
cast.description: Biscuit, a cheerful corgi with orange-and-white fur, big upright ears and a short fluffy tail, who walks on two legs and wears a tall white chef's hat and a small blue apron.

extras.music: Upbeat jazzy bossa nova with brushed drums and a light guitar, kept soft under the action.

shots.prompt: A medium shot of a cozy home kitchen in morning light, where Biscuit stands at the counter. Biscuit, a cheerful corgi with orange-and-white fur and big upright ears, in a tall white chef's hat and a small blue apron, reads a handwritten recipe card with drawings of three dishes and a soup. He wags his short fluffy tail, grabs an empty woven shopping basket and heads for the door. The camera holds a medium shot across the kitchen counter.

shots.prompt: A wide shot of a sunny little town street, where Biscuit rides a little red scooter toward a corner supermarket. Biscuit, a cheerful corgi with orange-and-white fur and big upright ears, in a tall white chef's hat and a small blue apron, scoots along the sidewalk on a little red kick scooter with the empty woven basket hanging from the handlebar. His ears flap in the wind and he waves at a passing bird. The camera tracks beside him at his eye level.
